description: Cite textual evidence to support analysis of what a text says explicitly and inferentially
Determine a theme and analyze its development over the course of a text
Analyze how dialogue or incidents propel the action and reveal character, including shifts in point of view
Determine the meaning of words and phrases, including figurative and connotative meanings
Cite textual evidence to support analysis of informational text
Determine a central idea and analyze its development, including through objective summary
Write arguments to support claims with clear reasons and relevant evidence
Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas clearly
Draw evidence from literary or informational texts to support analysis and research
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage
Demonstrate command of capitalization, punctuation, and spelling conventions
Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions, building on others' ideas
